CustomField.description:
The day the unpaid days on this request were converted to Annual leave. Payroll asks when a correction was made, not only that it was, and reports the month's conversions off this field.
A Date rather than a Date/Time on purpose. The figure is only ever read a day at a time, and a Date/Time would have had to be reduced to one for grouping — DATEVALUE converts in GMT, so a conversion made in the Bangkok morning of the 1st would have filed under the previous month. Ordering within a day is still on CreatedDate if anyone needs it.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The day this request was raised by an unpaid leave conversion. Set automatically.
CustomField.label: Converted Date
